theme: Light theme (Primary Navy, Secondary Gold, White background)

headings.rules: Must use tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`) for large sizes (text-4xl+). Line-height tight (`leading-none`) for headers. Never center by default.

body.rules: Loose leading (`leading-relaxed`) for readable paragraphs. Text scale text-base to text-lg.

overlines.rules: Must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs or text-sm), and wide spacing (`tracking-[0.2em]`). Use for section prefixes like '01 / ABOUT US'.

colors.rules: Use Navy Blue as the primary anchor for structure. Pair with Gold for highlights/CTAs. Do not use generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle mesh gradients.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows combined with precise direct shadows. (e.g., `shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,43,91,0.08)]`).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp edges with semi-transparent borders for cards (`border-primary/10`).
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero image MUST have a maximum overlay opacity of `bg-navy/50` or a gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-r from-[#002B5B]/90 via-[#002B5B]/60 to-transparent`). NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Use Glassmorphism with `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80` for light headers.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Duotone navy treatments for secondary images. Use clipped frames and spotlight layouts rather than standard full-width strips.

layouts.hero: Full screen (`min-h-screen`) with kinetic typography. Line-by-line masked text reveal on load. Asymmetrical arrangement of text. Dual CTAs prominent.
layouts.sections: Generous spacing philosophy (`py-24`, `py-32`). Use asymmetrical grids. Numbered manifesto-style chapters for About/Visi-Misi.
layouts.bento_grid: For 'Why Choose Us' and 'Services', use an asymmetrical grid (e.g., The 'Tetris' grid). Some items span 2 columns, others 1, with varying heights.

motion.scrolling: MUST use `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Use `framer-motion` for scroll-reveals. Staggered fade-up, clip-path reveals for images.
motion.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee` for a slow editorial ribbon containing brand heritage ('Since 2014'). Very slow, smooth drift with large spacing.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons must slightly scale up or translate-y, with color transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Text over images must have shadow or dark overlay.
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta-quote"`).

media.3d_libraries: Framer Motion for 2.5D layer parallax in the hero.

hero_background.description: Cargo ship navigating open sea, used for the main hero background.

marine_supply.description: Fishing boat deck with crates, used for Marine Supply / Working Gear service card.

crew_documentation.description: Sailors in uniform, used for Crew Documentation service.

visa_services.description: Open passport with travel stamps, used for Visa & Embassy Services card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure tailwind.config.js with primary #002B5B, secondary #C89B3C, background #FFFFFF, accent #F4F6F8.
Ensure the hero immediately shows the tagline, headline, short description, and both CTAs.
Language switcher (ID/EN toggle) should be functional, switching hardcoded text strings.
Form Modal: 'Request Quotation' opens a Shadcn UI Dialog containing a Contact Form (Name, Company, Email, Phone, Service, Message) that handles a mock backend submission.
WhatsApp Link: 'Hubungi Kami' opens a new tab to WhatsApp (`https://wa.me/6281261147333`).
Create a slow editorial marquee separating the Hero and the About Us section.
Use standard raw HTML+Tailwind tags for the marketing sections structure, avoid using rigid 'Card' wrappers when asymmetrical overlaps are needed.
No generic centered templates. Build with high-contrast text layers and intentional asymmetry.
Footer must be dark (navy) with high contrast against the light body sections.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_slop: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use bold typography and generous spacing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.styling: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Avoid complete transparent backgrounds in navigation. Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.animations: Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties. Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, parallax).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.icons: Never use emoji characters for icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: All interactive elements must have `data-testid` attributes.
